messages:
clare_csm: Heads-up: OrionForms renewal ~41 days out. MAU down ~53% last 30d (active seats 310 -> 145). Our champion (M. Ellis) moved to a new role last week and hasn't made introductions.

infra-bot: Automated usage alert for acct_orionforms: -53% 30d vs baseline. Alert ID: UDA-20260620-19.

noah_ae: heard procurement ran a quick demo with "FormCraft". Any telemetry showing platform errors or missed callbacks?

ari_se: onboarding checklist shows webhook validation failing and repeated 502/504 during their nightly sync. Also a short burst of 429s on our gateway. Log snippet: ```
2026-06-20T03:12:11Z WARN 502 /v1/webhook acct=orionforms req_id=hb-202
2026-06-20T03:12:12Z ERROR 504 /v1/webhook acct=orionforms req_id=hb-203
2026-06-20T03:12:59Z ERROR 429 /v1/generate acct=orionforms pid=gw-17
```

clare_csm: that nightly sync powers their billing reconciliation. If callbacks failed they likely paused jobs and saw subsequent usage drop. New PM listed in Okta as "P. Ibarra" but no replies yet.

dina_head: two-track response: (1) infra triage immediately to confirm whether failures were on our edge and run backfill if needed; (2) commercial + CSM outreach to re-engage new PM and procurement. Prioritize triage.

noah_ae: approve offering 10 SE hours and a small credit contingent on root cause. I'll hold on formal terms until triage complete.

ari_se: Action: I'll correlate gateway spikes with webhook retries and determine whether we can recovery-backfill missed callbacks. ETA 4h.

clare_csm: Outreach draft to P Ibarra: "Hi P We've seen a drop in activity and noticed M moved teams. Can we schedule a 30m triage + adoption call this week? We can assign SE hours to finish integration and will share remediation plan if any transient errors were on our side." Approve?

noah_ae: approve. Add: "we're also preparing a short remediation note and can offer SE hours this week to finish validation."

dina_head: also create a renewal_watch in SF and flag for AM attention. If infra caused request loss, prepare credit language and an exec-facing summary for renewal discussion.

infra-bot: Reminder: create renewal_watch ticket in Salesforce (acct_orionforms, renewal_41d)  ticket #RW-20260620-55.

clare_csm: Created SF ticket RW-20260620-55 and linked to playbook onboarding-rescue-v2. Assign: ari -> log summary + backfill plan in 4h, noah -> contact procurement and new PM, clare -> prepare renewal brief and proposed retention package.

ari_se: quick update after initial scan: gateway throttling (short spike) caused 429s; webhook proxy returned some 502s on retries. Recommend: (a) run recovery job for missed callbacks; (b) temporarily raise soft-throttle for acct_orionforms; (c) schedule a 60m SE session to finish webhook validation.

clare_csm: perfect. I'll propose SE session times and include remediation plan. Will update this thread when recovery job completes. :white_check_mark:
